title: Why Do We Yawn? (And Why Is It Contagious?)
short_title: Why Do We Yawn? Why Is It Contagious?
description: Why do we yawn, and why does seeing someone yawn make you yawn too? Here is what scientists think.
comment: Did you just yawn reading this? Tell me! 🥱

scenes.text: Why do we yawn, and why is it so contagious?
Scientists are still not sure. But one popular idea is that yawning helps cool your brain.
When you yawn, you pull in a big gulp of cooler air, and the stretch pushes blood around your face and head.
That may help cool the brain and keep you alert. This is why people yawn when tired or bored.
Contagious yawning may be a social habit. Seeing someone yawn makes you copy them, even in dogs and chimps.
